testimonial.title: What Customers Say
testimonial.quote: I rarely write reviews, but this experience truly deserves one. I ordered a bouquet for my mother's birthday and wanted everything to be perfect. From the moment I placed the order, I was continuously updated on its delivery status, which gave me great peace of mind. When the flowers arrived, they were even more beautiful than I imagined - fresh, vibrant, and arranged with great elegance. My mother was deeply moved when she received them. Thank you for turning a simple gift into an unforgettable moment for my family.

dailyFlowers.title: Everyday Flowers
dailyFlowers.description: You don't need a special occasion to keep flowers at home. Every bouquet is carefully selected and elegantly arranged to bring natural beauty into the simplest moments of your day.

hero.title: Our Story
hero.intro: The story of Hoa Theo Mua is the story of
hero.introAfter: - about the emotions of flowers, of memories, and of empathy from the soul of a woman who wished to bring peaceful values and nurture positivity through every heartfelt tale.
hero.subtitle: Hanoi - 12 Flower Seasons
hero.story1: For anyone who has lingered in Hanoi, memories of the flower seasons are among the most profound.
hero.story2: The wistful emotion of pausing by flower-laden bicycles drifting through the alleys… every change of season stirs the soul in its own surprising way.
hero.story3: And it was with that very emotion, while humming along to the song "Hanoi's 12 Flower Seasons", that something natural awakened within me.
hero.founderAvatarAlt: Portrait of CEO Le Thi Hoa Dao
hero.closing: From the desire to bring those peaceful emotions, Hoa Theo Mua has distilled its own brand values - the good things meant to be entrusted in every product.

visionMission.title: Vision & Mission
visionMission.motto:
A flower is most beautiful when it blooms in its season,
you are most beautiful when you are happy

vision.label: Vision
vision.statement: A joyful world where beauty is present in every single moment

mission.label: Mission
mission.statement: To bring emotional experiences to everyone through each fresh flower harvested straight from the garden, wrapped with love.

values.title: Values We Pursue
values.description: Every Hoa Theo Mua bouquet carries the things we believe in and hold dear.

emotion.title: Touching Emotions
emotion.description: Hoa Theo Mua doesn't only craft beautiful bouquets - we tuck a quiet kindness into every petal. Each arrangement speaks the feelings that are hard to say, so the recipient feels the sender's sincere care.

enjoy.title: Enjoy Life
enjoy.description: We believe a fresh vase of flowers each day can awaken a positive energy for living. Hoa Theo Mua shares the spirit of savoring life - noticing and loving the small things around you.

simple.title: Simple
simple.description: Inspired by pure, natural beauty - no flourish, no fuss - Hoa Theo Mua chooses the most honest form of each bloom. That simplicity makes it easy for anyone to feel and connect with.

elegant.title: Refined
elegant.description: Hoa Theo Mua understands and celebrates the beauty of flowers for women. Every small detail - from color palette to arrangement - is tended with care, bringing a sense of harmony and love.

eco.title: Protect the Environment
eco.description: We prioritize sustainable materials, reduce waste, and say "yes" to products that are both beautiful and kind to nature - because a greener planet is worth caring for, together.

vietnamese.title: Honoring Vietnamese Values
vietnamese.description: Hoa Theo Mua cherishes and honors Vietnamese values - from raw materials and flowers to the way our artisans place the soul of Vietnamese florals into every piece.

productLines.title: Main Product Lines
productLines.description: Fresh bouquets designed with care in a natural style - capturing the beauty and vitality of each season, made to gift the people you cherish on every special occasion.

myDuyen.quote: I'm very satisfied with Hoa Theo Mua's service. The designs are diverse and fit many occasions. The consultants are warm and ready to help me choose the perfect bouquet. The flowers are beautiful and refined - I'll keep supporting Hoa Theo Mua many more times!

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to what corporate buyers usually ask before getting in touch.

pricing.question: How is B2B floral service pricing calculated?
pricing.answer: Pricing depends on three factors: delivery frequency (daily/weekly), the flower selection, and the number of locations. HTM offers packages from essentials to premium - matched to office, hotel or bank budgets. Send your specific requirements via <zalo>Zalo</zalo> and our team will quote within 30 minutes.

quality.question: How does HTM handle deliveries that don't meet quality standards?
quality.answer: Flowers that arrive wilted, off-brief or delivered late are replaced free of charge the same day. This is built into every corporate contract - partner satisfaction is our benchmark.

moq.question: What's the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for corporate contracts?
moq.answer: MOQ depends on the service tier your business selects. Send your specific requirements via <zalo>Zalo</zalo> and our team will support you within 30 minutes.

contractTerm.question: What's the minimum contract length?
contractTerm.answer: 3 months lets your business experience the quality before committing longer - no lock-in if it doesn't feel right.

customization.question: Can HTM customise flowers to match our brand colours or identity?
customization.answer: Yes. We arrange flowers around your brand palette, seasonal reception theme or event concept. Share your logo or colour swatches and our design team will mock up samples before contract signing.

coverage.question: Which cities do you currently deliver to?
coverage.answer: We currently serve Ho Chi Minh City only. For areas outside HCMC, message us on <zalo>Zalo</zalo> and we'll check bespoke delivery options.

flexibility.question: Can we reschedule or pause a recurring delivery?
flexibility.answer: Yes. Just give us 72 hours' notice via Zalo or email, and HTM will adjust the schedule at no extra cost.

cta.title: Let's create something blooming together
cta.description: Tell us about your project - we'll get back within 4 working hours with first ideas and a clear next step.
